sourceTraceability.integrityRule: This review pack may be schema-validated, canonically hashed and readiness-assessed only. It must not be selected for a determination until successor execution and required approvals are separately delivered.

lifecyclePolicy.reResolutionRule: Requirements must never silently re-resolve between explicit host-invoked checkpoints. Risk and evidence changes are applied only when the host invokes an approved UBO re-resolution checkpoint.

limited_liability_partnership.economicInterestLabel: rights to surplus assets on winding up

definitions.economic_interest: The applicable economic ownership/control interest depends on entity profile. For a COMPANY, this includes direct or indirect ownership of shares or rights to capital/economic value. For an LLP, this includes direct or indirect rights to share in more than the relevant threshold of surplus assets on winding up and any other economic/control interest required by applicable beneficial-owner rules.
definitions.beneficial_owner: Any natural person satisfying the applicable beneficial ownership or control test for the customer under this policy, including ultimate economic ownership, voting control, management appointment/removal control or other ultimate control.
definitions.indirect_ownership_calculation: Where an economic or voting interest is capable of percentage look-through, interests are calculated through intermediate entities using deterministic graph rules. Percentage interests through a chain are multiplied and qualifying independent paths to the same natural person are aggregated, subject to duplicate-interest, range and cycle rules.
definitions.voting_control: Holding, directly or indirectly, more than {param:voting_threshold_pct}% of the applicable voting rights, including where voting rights diverge from economic ownership through share classes, LLP agreements or other governance arrangements.
definitions.significant_control_other_means: The right to exercise, or actual exercise of, significant influence or control over the customer or its management by means other than the primary economic-interest, voting-right or appointment/removal tests. This may include qualifying decision rights, veto rights, dominant influence or de facto control and may require analyst interpretation.
definitions.appointment_removal_control: For a COMPANY, the right to appoint or remove a majority of the board of directors. For an LLP, the right to appoint or remove the majority of the persons entitled to participate in the LLP's management.
definitions.qualifying_person: Any natural person identified through an applicable ownership/control test, plus a senior managing official recorded through a permitted fallback.
definitions.senior_management_candidate: A natural person explicitly established as part of the customer's senior management from registry facts, existing evidence, held case data or customer response. This preparatory classification is not beneficial-owner status and does not apply the senior-managing-official fallback role.
definitions.senior_managing_official: A senior person responsible for managing the customer who may be treated as the beneficial owner only where the applicable statutory and policy conditions for fallback have been satisfied and the required measures taken have been documented.
definitions.positive_registry_evidence: A registry record positively stating that a named person/entity has an ownership or control relationship. Positive evidence may support that fact subject to the relevant requirement's evidence rules.
definitions.negative_registry_evidence: A registry result capable of establishing that a relevant relationship does not exist. Absence of a particular PSC nature-of-control code must not automatically be treated as negative proof that no such control exists.
definitions.unresolvable_ownership: Two distinct states must be distinguished. FALLBACK_ELIGIBLE means the required reasonable/exhaustive measures were actually completed but no natural-person beneficial owner could be identified or the firm remains unsatisfied that the identified person is the beneficial owner, and the applicable senior-managing-official fallback may therefore be considered. CDD_UNABLE_TO_COMPLETE means required measures themselves could not be completed, including because required evidence is unobtainable, the applicant refuses or fails to respond, or the structure remains impenetrable. In that state the relationship must follow the applicable CDD-failure/decline process and SAR relevance must be considered separately. Customer communications concerning any SAR must follow the platform's separate SAR/tipping-off communication policy.

ownership_threshold_pct.bound: Immutable statutory threshold in this Policy Pack; a separate stricter firm collection threshold cannot suppress statutory qualification.

voting_threshold_pct.bound: Immutable statutory threshold in this Policy Pack; a separate stricter firm collection threshold cannot suppress statutory qualification.

chain_depth_risk_floor_layers.bound: Firm appetite. Lower is more conservative.

attestation_max_risk_level.bound: May be lowered or attestation disabled. Negative attestation alone must not satisfy the defined control requirements for a HIGH-risk case.

min_evidence_strength_control.bound: May be raised. HIGH must not be below documentary strength for control requirements.

min_evidence_strength_ownership.bound: May be raised. Ownership structure must not resolve solely through uncorroborated customer attestation.

required_independent_ownership_corrobora.bound: Firm policy. Means at least one source independent of the applicant must corroborate the controlling ownership layer where UBO-R08 requires corroboration.

rfi_expiry_days.bound: Firm standard; expiry consequences are governed by the relevant requirement.

periodic_review_months.bound: Firm policy. Any policy departure requiring approval is handled outside the UBO engine.

strengthScale.2: Company-originated governance or ownership document with usable internal consistency.
strengthScale.4: Official or equivalent high-authority source record.

evidenceModel.noStrengthAggregation: Evidence strengths are not additive. Two strength-1 attestations do not become strength 2.
evidenceModel.sufficiencyRule: Meeting a numeric strength threshold does not by itself resolve a requirement where can_resolve_alone=false, corroboration_required=true, resolution_effect=POSITIVE_ONLY or analyst interpretation is required.
evidenceModel.conflictRule: Evidence Platform/capabilities preserve competing facts. UBO determines operative claims. A high-authority source does not automatically overwrite a later or semantically different source without adjudication.
evidenceModel.temporalRule: Captured date, source effective date and ceased/current state must remain distinguishable. Stale and superseded evidence remains part of historical decision reconstruction.

items.caveat: PSC information is valuable official register evidence but must not be treated as exhaustive negative proof of every possible control basis.

roleProjection.Note: UBO identifies qualifying roles. The wider KYC/onboarding policy owns IDV, POI, POA, screening and verification workflow execution.

roles.trigger: qualifies through applicable management appointment/removal test
qualifies through significant influence/control by other means
nominee relationship establishes another natural person as underlying owner/controller

roleProjection.handoffRule: For every projected qualifying person, UBO returns canonical person reference, role(s), qualifying basis, known identity attributes and missing identity attributes. The downstream KYC policy determines identity verification, screening and document requirements.

requirements.title: Ultimate qualifying economic interests identified
requirements.description: At the regulated subject, determine qualifying economic interests using effective-interest, future PSC attribution and future layer-closure outputs. Resolve causal frontier edges rather than creating a requirement for every intermediary; a terminal natural person is not automatically a UBO.
testAssertions: Regulated-subject economic qualification is distinct from intermediary discovery.
Causal frontier or relationship gaps are not fanned out per intermediary.
Natural-person status alone never establishes qualification.

resolutionStrategies.note: PSC information may positively support ownership/control but does not by itself establish exhaustive completeness.

requirements.title: Indirect ownership/control interest calculated through all applicable layers
requirements.description: Derive applicability from canonical graph depth and active calculations in an earlier approved phase. Missing relationships or values create needs only at the blocking edge, with affected paths retained as diagnostics.

failureOutcome.note: Missing or non-computable layer interests create InformationNeeds and block any conclusion dependent on those paths.

testAssertions: Applicability is graph-derived rather than caller ownership-layer input.
One blocking edge is one causal need even when several paths depend on it.

resolutionStrategies.note: Calculated from operative graph claims. No customer question may resolve this requirement directly.

requirements.title: Every material intermediate entity and relevant relationship evidenced
requirements.description: Derive intermediate-structure applicability from the canonical graph. Keep entity existence, relationship proof and currentness distinct while grouping one causal frontier or structure-evidence need where appropriate.

regulatory.provision: Reg 28 — ownership/control structure and beneficial ownership

testAssertions: Applicability is graph-derived.
One artifact remains one source even when it yields several extracted facts.
Entity and relationship evidence remain separate semantics.

requirements.title: Voting control assessed
requirements.description: Always assess voting at the regulated subject. Create intermediary voting needs only on material control or attribution routes or positive signals; numeric customer questions are last-resort gated and remain disabled pending A-04 and A-17.

attestation.conditions: Negative attestation only. A positive answer always requires identification of the relevant person/entity and supporting evidence or review.
attestation.statement: The applicant confirms that no person holds voting rights above the applicable threshold other than as disclosed.

resolutionStrategies.note: Positive PSC voting information may establish a candidate relationship. Absence of such a code does not automatically prove there is no undisclosed voting-control arrangement.

testAssertions: Economic and voting dimensions remain independent.
No universal intermediary voting need is created.
Numeric voting input remains gated and disabled.

requirements.title: Management appointment/removal control assessed
requirements.description: Assess appointment/removal control at the regulated subject, preserving combined or alternative source semantics. Majority scope must be established before automatic qualification; customer input remains last-resort gated.

attestation.statement: The applicant confirms that no person has undisclosed rights to appoint or remove a majority of the applicable management body.

testAssertions: Combined source wording is not split into stronger independent assertions.
Majority scope is required for qualification.
Automatic Companies House qualification remains disabled pending A-12.

requirements.title: Other significant influence or control assessed
requirements.description: Assess positive other or management-control facts deterministically only where supported; ambiguous or de facto control requires review. A negative statement may later be separate residual content but is disabled pending A-02 and A-17.

attestation.conditions: Negative attestation only. Positive assertions of control require supporting facts and may require analyst interpretation.
attestation.statement: The applicant confirms that no other person exercises significant influence or control beyond the ownership, voting and management rights disclosed.

testAssertions: Positive and negative legs remain distinct.
Ambiguous or de facto control routes to review.
No unsigned residual statement resolves this requirement.

resolutionStrategies.note: Absence of an 'other significant control' PSC code cannot resolve this requirement negatively.

requirements.title: Minimum identity attributes captured for qualifying persons
requirements.description: Derive applicability from actual statutory or firm-policy qualifying-person results in the prior phase and collect only missing UBO-owned identity attributes; IDV, POI, POA and screening remain outside UBO Control.

firmPolicy: Canonical-person identity and downstream handoff policy

failureOutcome.note: Downstream verification cannot begin until minimum required identity attributes are available.

resolutionStrategies.note: May provide only a subset of identity attributes.
Collect only missing attributes for already-resolved qualifying persons.

testAssertions: Applicability comes from actual qualification output.
Only missing UBO-owned identity attributes are requested.
Downstream KYC responsibilities remain separate.

requirements.title: Controlling ownership structure independently corroborated
requirements.description: Maintain one subject or structure-level independent-corroboration requirement. Multiple facts extracted from one artifact remain one source, and registry-band consistency does not verify an exact declared value.

regulatory.provision: Reg 28 — reasonable measures and understanding ownership/control

testAssertions: One artifact is one independent source regardless of extracted fact count.
Independent band corroboration is not exact-value verification.
The requirement remains structure-level rather than per edge.

resolutionStrategies.note: Compare customer-declared/current operative structure with an independent registry or equivalent source.
This customer-originated document does not itself count as the required independent source.

requirements.title: PSC register discrepancy assessment completed
requirements.description: Classify future PSC differences as REGISTER_SCOPE_DIFFERENCE, METHOD_DIFFERENCE, TIMING_STALENESS or MATERIAL_DISCREPANCY. Only analyst-confirmed material discrepancy may produce a host-facing Regulation 30A report candidate.

failureOutcome.note: The HOLD is an internal operating policy for unresolved material discrepancies, not an assertion that every discrepancy legally prohibits onboarding.

requirements.reportingRule: Only discrepancies meeting the applicable materiality/reportability test are routed for Reg 30A reporting.
testAssertions: Definition and method differences are not automatically material discrepancies.
Timing or staleness remains distinct.
No automatic regulatory submission occurs.

resolutionStrategies.note: Compare final operative UBO/control claims with applicable Companies House PSC evidence.

requirements.title: Senior managing official fallback
requirements.description: Retain the current asynchronous fallback boundary. Future review records case-specific measure-category dispositions and reasons; NO_DATA never proves exhaustion and an authorised analyst or compliance decision remains required.
testAssertions: Current asynchronous fallback semantics are retained.
NO_DATA never proves exhaustion.
Non-executed future measure categories require reasons.

resolutionStrategies.note: A case-pinned measures-taken manifest and authoritative asynchronous exhaustion decision must exist before fallback eligibility can be derived.

requirements.title: Trust in ownership/control chain detected and routed
requirements.description: Keep positive trust or similar-arrangement signals independent and route them appropriately. A future negative residual statement remains separate and disabled pending A-02 and A-17.

failureOutcome.note: MVP does not force trusts into ordinary corporate ownership recursion.

resolutionStrategies.note: May be detected from registry/entity type, extracted evidence or declared structure.

testAssertions: Positive trust signals remain independent.
No unsigned negative statement resolves this requirement.

requirements.title: Nominee and bearer-share arrangements assessed
requirements.description: Keep positive nominee or bearer signals independent and resolve an underlying principal where required. A future negative residual statement remains separate and disabled pending A-02 and A-17.

failureOutcome.note: Any prohibited bearer-share outcome is determined by the wider customer-acceptance policy.

testAssertions: Positive nominee and bearer signals remain independent.
No unsigned negative statement resolves this requirement.

requirements.title: Ownership/control chain depth and cross-border character assessed
requirements.description: Derive graph depth and cross-border character in the canonical graph phase for later policy use, while emitting UBO risk signals only and never mutating authoritative host risk.
testAssertions: Structural depth is derived before dependent applicability.
Only UBO-owned risk signals are emitted.
Host risk is never mutated.

requirements.title: Residual completeness attestation
requirements.description: Final structure completeness remains a distinct residual statement that cannot cure unresolved underlying requirements. It remains disabled pending A-02 and A-17.

attestation.conditions: This attestation is a completeness backstop rather than standalone proof of underlying ownership/control facts.

statementByEntityProfile.COMPANY: I confirm that the ownership and control information provided is complete and accurate and that no other person owns more than {param:ownership_threshold_pct}% of the shares or voting rights in, or otherwise exercises qualifying control over, this business.
statementByEntityProfile.LLP: I confirm that the ownership and control information provided is complete and accurate and that no other person has rights above the applicable threshold in the LLP's surplus assets or voting rights, or otherwise exercises qualifying control over the LLP.

failureOutcome.note: Refusal to provide required completion confirmation prevents completion of the ownership/control section and follows the wider CDD failure policy.

resolutionStrategies.note: Presented exactly once at the ownership/control submit gate after all other requirements are RESOLVED, N_A or in an explicitly permitted review state.

testAssertions: Final confirmation cannot cure another requirement.
Residual statements remain separately stored.
No unsigned final wording is executable.

createWhen: A policy requirement needs a fact not established to required sufficiency.
A legal entity holds a potentially qualifying ownership/control right and ultimate natural-person resolution is required.
A capability returns PARTIAL, NO_DATA, INCONCLUSIVE or UNSUPPORTED and another policy-permitted resolution strategy remains.
Evidence strength is below the applicable requirement minimum.
Evidence conflicts and additional information may resolve the conflict.
doNotCreateWhen: The only issue is a transient capability status UNAVAILABLE or FAILED; create an operational retry/hold instead.
The case is already routed to a terminal specialist state and no further automated resolution is permitted by policy.
informationNeedPolicy.sourceSemanticsNote: Extraction is a candidate-fact production capability, not by itself a policy reason that a requirement is resolved. Customer documents are obtained through the CUSTOMER_DOCUMENT resolution strategy and may be interpreted through ExtractionService.

RESOLVED.description: All applicable mandatory requirements are resolved and all required determinations can be made.

RESOLVED_PROVISIONALLY.description: Policy explicitly allows progression on provisional evidence/review state. Use only where a requirement expressly permits it.

RESOLVED_VIA_SMO_FALLBACK.description: Fallback conditions were actually met after required measures were exhausted and the senior managing official fallback was applied and documented.

SPECIALIST_REVIEW_REQUIRED.description: The case contains a structure or legal/control interpretation outside the deterministic MVP, including trust resolution or ambiguous/de facto control.

UNRESOLVABLE.description: Required ownership/control facts could not be established.

CDD_FAILURE.description: Applicable required CDD measures cannot be completed. The wider onboarding policy determines relationship decline/termination and SAR handling.

textByEntityProfile.COMPANY: Please identify each person or legal entity that currently owns shares in {subject.display_name}. For each shareholder, provide their name and the percentage of shares they own. If the exact percentage is not known, provide the ownership range or other ownership information you know. For a legal-entity shareholder, also provide its registration number and jurisdiction where known.

DISCLOSE_TRUST_IN_CHAIN.note: The supplied source policy referenced B2 but did not include its full template text. Do not invent wording.

DISCLOSE_OTHER_SIGNIFICANT_CONTROL.note: The supplied source policy referenced B4 but did not include its full template text. Do not invent wording.

CAPTURE_QUALIFYING_PERSON_IDENTITY.note: UBO-R07 referenced B1 for collection of missing identity attributes, but the supplied source policy did not include the full interaction template. Do not infer that ownership-disclosure wording is suitable.

textByEntityProfile.COMPANY: Does any person hold more than {param:voting_threshold_pct}% of the voting rights in the business other than through the share ownership already provided?
textByEntityProfile.LLP: Does any person hold more than {param:voting_threshold_pct}% of the voting rights on matters decided by the LLP's members, other than as already disclosed?

DISCLOSE_VOTING_CONTROL.onYes: Identify the person or legal entity. If a legal entity holds the right, create an InformationNeed to resolve the natural persons ultimately exercising that control. Obtain appropriate governance evidence.
DISCLOSE_VOTING_CONTROL.onNo: Record negative attestation where permitted by case risk and UBO-R04.

textByEntityProfile.COMPANY: Does any individual or entity have the right to appoint or remove a majority of the company's directors?
textByEntityProfile.LLP: Does any individual or entity have the right to appoint or remove the majority of the persons entitled to participate in management of the LLP?

DISCLOSE_APPOINTMENT_REMOVAL_CONTROL.onYes: Identify the person or entity and request applicable governance evidence. Legal-entity holders create a further InformationNeed for ultimate natural-person control.
DISCLOSE_APPOINTMENT_REMOVAL_CONTROL.onNo: Record negative attestation where permitted by case risk and UBO-R05.

IDENTIFY_SENIOR_MANAGEMENT_CANDIDATES.text: Please identify the most senior individual or individuals responsible for managing the business.
IDENTIFY_SENIOR_MANAGEMENT_CANDIDATES.shownWhen: A fallback review candidate exists and sufficient senior-management candidate information is not already established. This question is preparatory and must not establish fallback eligibility, beneficial-owner status or the SMO fallback role.

textByEntityProfile.COMPANY: Are any shares or ownership interests held by a nominee on behalf of another person, or has the company issued bearer shares?
textByEntityProfile.LLP: Is any membership, economic or voting interest held by one person or entity on behalf of another person?

DISCLOSE_NOMINEE_OR_BEARER_ARRANGEMENT.onYes: Identify the underlying person and obtain evidence sufficient to establish the underlying relationship.
DISCLOSE_NOMINEE_OR_BEARER_ARRANGEMENT.onNo: Record negative attestation where permitted by UBO-R12.

DISCLOSE_LLP_SURPLUS_ASSET_RIGHTS.text: Please identify each person or entity with rights to share in the LLP's surplus assets on winding up, and state the percentage or basis of that entitlement where known.
DISCLOSE_LLP_SURPLUS_ASSET_RIGHTS.onSubmit: Corporate/legal-entity holders create InformationNeeds for further look-through until qualifying natural persons are established or a permitted terminal outcome applies.
